comfyui.finding: The integration boundary is the HTTP API (submit a graph, poll history, cancel, view outputs, free). Yamakan wraps it as an engine (ladder D) in a separate contained process; no ComfyUI source is copied. ComfyUI custom nodes execute arbitrary Python, so only a pinned node set may be installed.

openvideostudio.identityContracts: Frozen dataclasses ReferenceImage(path, view), CharacterAsset(character_id, root, description, reference_images, clothing, accessories, embeddings, bible_version), IdentityEncoding(character_id, provider, method, payload, metadata), IdentityApplication(prompt, controls, metadata).
openvideostudio.comfyClient: ComfyClient(server default http://127.0.0.1:8188): is_available, upload_input_image, submit, wait_for_result (polling), cancel, output_path, free. Uses requests and a local comfy_root path.
openvideostudio.finding: Identity contracts are small and pure: port to TypeScript/zod (ladder B) keyed by canonical asset ids instead of paths. The ComfyUI client shape is a direct reference for Yamakan's engine adapter; its polling and filesystem output lookup are replaced by job attempts and content-addressed import.

openmontage.manifestShape: name, version, description, category, stability, default_checkpoint_policy, stages[] with name, required_artifacts_in, produces, tools_available, checkpoint_required, human_approval_default, success_criteria
openmontage.checkpointFunctions: validate_checkpoint, init_project, _enforce_stage_prerequisites, _archive_superseded_checkpoint, write_checkpoint, read_checkpoint, get_latest_checkpoint, get_completed_stages, get_next_stage (JSON Schema validated, file-per-stage under PROJECTS_DIR)
openmontage.finding: The manifest format and prerequisite rules are the reusable part; the file checkpoint store would be a second authority and is rejected. Port the manifest schema and prerequisite/approval rules onto durable jobs and revisions (ladder B), keeping AGPL notices on the ported files.

filmEditor.finding: No donor module renders a video clip's own sound; the MVP defect is fixed in Yamakan's own render plan. The remote mastering provider is excluded (hosted service).

yamakanDefect.observation: AudioInstruction entries are created only when the clip's track is a sound track or the asset is audio (line 140 at main 6e471088); video assets add only picture layers. Recorded as open in specs/CURRENT.md (found 2026-10-13).
